data.spiritual_significance: The name Gaelle has a spiritual meaning rooted in faith and hope. It is a reminder that even when we may feel like strangers or foreigners in the world, God is always with us and promises to guide and care for us.

historical_references.reference: Gaëlle was a Breton martyr venerated in the diocese of Quimper. Her name appears in a list of saints in a 10th-century Breton martyrology. The details of her life and martyrdom are not known, but she is believed to have suffered for her faith during the pagan invasions of the late 5th and early 6th centuries.

In the 11th century, Gaëlle appeared in several miraculous healings reported in the region of Anjou in France. The most famous of these stories involved a woman who was healed of a paralyzing illness after praying to Gaëlle.
